t: A tiny, low-cost FPGA board for learning digital design with open tools.
steps: Buy the Tang Primer 25K with its dock from the Sipeed AliExpress store or a marketplace.
Get a USB-C cable to connect it to your computer.
Install Gowin EDA V1.9.9 Beta-4 or newer, or the open Apicula, Yosys, and nextpnr tools.
Download the Sipeed Tang Primer 25K example repo.
Choose Device Version A in the IDE settings for units that need it.
Build the blink example and load it with the Gowin programmer or openFPGALoader.
Add a PMOD HDMI module and try a video example next.
meta: Open Board. From $25.53. A few stores.
